# SSG Themes

> Twenty production themes for Static Site Generator (SSG), spanning
> publishing, portfolios, finance, commerce, health, sport and SaaS. Each has
> its own design system and layout set, built on a shared template
> architecture, with every accessibility and performance claim enforced by
> a CI gate.

## Themes

- [Apex](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/apex/): portfolio and consulting theme. Cool neutrals, deep blue accent, seven layouts.
- [Atlas](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/atlas/): editorial and knowledge-hub theme. Serif reading column at a 72-character measure, forest-green accent, eight layouts.
- [Cadence](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/cadence/): performance-cycling theme. Dark cinematic stage, rider abstraction and evidence-led specifications.
- [Covenant](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/covenant/): private-capital theme. Black, ivory and red geometry with rigorous portfolio narratives.
- [Hearth](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/hearth/): furniture-catalogue theme. Airy product staging, warm materials and practical ownership content.
- [Intent](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/intent/): editorial design portfolio. Expressive serif type, monochrome fields and a studio-ribbon motif.
- [Kairo](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/kairo/): creative-direction portfolio. Cinematic type, energetic orange geometry and substantial case studies.
- [Kaishi](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/kaishi/): Apple-inspired starter theme. Translucent sticky header, pill controls, soft card geometry.
- [Kinetic](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/kinetic/): multi-product SaaS and launch theme. Violet-to-cyan decoration, tabbed tour, five layouts.
- [Lucid](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/lucid/): documentation theme in the U.S. Web Design System documentation-page pattern. Side navigation, in-page contents, English and French.
- [Noir](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/noir/): streetwear-commerce theme. Near-black staging, hard editorial rules and transparent product information.
- [Prism](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/prism/): financial-infrastructure marketing theme. Navy masthead with a disclosure mega-menu, sloped hero with product mock-ups, four semantic tints, four layouts.
- [Quill](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/quill/): typographic blog theme. Large tight-tracked wordmark, full-bleed hero, monochrome palette, English and French.
- [Scout](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/scout/): AI-shopping theme. Bold commerce type, modular product cards and transparent recommendations.
- [Signal](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/signal/): revenue-intelligence theme. Luminous dashboard surfaces and explainable AI content.
- [Stablo](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/stablo/): editorial blog theme. Centred wordmark, large featured cards, category labels and bylines, English and French.
- [Steward](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/steward/): institutional-finance theme. Editorial serif type, ledger grid and trust-led service narratives.
- [Velocity](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/velocity/): product landing and starter theme. Slate and bronze, seven layouts.
- [Visage](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/visage/): aesthetic-health theme. Clinical whitespace, consent-led copy and a private consultation journey.
- [Voxt](https://themes.static-site-generator.com/voxt/): developer tools and AI environment showcase theme. Terminal IDE dock preview, feature grids, strict CSP.

## Verified properties

- Colour tokens clear WCAG 1.4.6 AAA contrast (7:1 for text, 3:1 for borders and focus rings) in both light and dark, checked by `scripts/contrast.py` on every commit.
- Rendered contrast, 44px target size, heading order, reflow at 320px and focus visibility are measured in a browser by `tests/aaa/` and `tests/responsive/` over every built page.
- Zero third-party requests on every page: no CDN, webfont host, analytics or tag manager.
- Every page under 20 KB gzipped including CSS and JS, gated by `scripts/pageweight.py`.

## Not claimed

- Not full WCAG AAA conformance: AAA includes manual criteria no theme can satisfy alone. The automated gates cover contrast, target size, reflow, focus and structure.
- No fixed Lighthouse score: Lighthouse runs in CI but a score depends on host and network.

## Requirements

Requires ssg 0.0.50 or later. Source: https://github.com/sebastienrousseau/ssg-themes.github.io
